edition.notes: The official Latin text of the eight responsa as printed under Commissio de re Biblica, with the notice that Pope Pius X ratified them and ordered their publication.
edition.title: De auctoribus et de tempore compositionis Psalmorum

passages.context: Responsa I-VIII deny that David must be held the sole author of every Psalm while affirming the antiquity and ordinary evidentiary weight of the titles, David as principal author, the Davidic origin of Psalms expressly attributed to him in Scripture, the possibility of division, combination, and slight liturgical revision, and the prophetic and Messianic character of multiple Psalms.
passages.notes: Read visually in the official-gazette page images. The constituent begins below the preceding letter on p. 354 and concludes with the approval notice and consultors' signatures on p. 355.
